question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The speaker delivered an __engaging__ speech that inspired the audience.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Captivating**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Engaging"** means something that is attractive or holds attention, often because it is interesting or compelling. (आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's engaging lecture kept the students interested throughout the class.
 
 
 
• **"Captivating" **refers to something that is enchanting or fascinating, capable of holding someone's complete attention. (मोहक)
 
 
• **Example: **The captivating scenery of the mountains left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym for **'engaging' **is **'captivating'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Captivating**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dreary **(उबाऊ): Something that is dull, boring, or uninteresting.

 
 
• **Example:** The dreary weather made everyone feel lazy and unmotivated.
 
 
 
• **Important **(महत्वपूर्ण): Something that has great significance or value.
 
 
• **Example: ** It is important to study thoroughly before exams.
 
 
 
• **Unnecessary** (अनावश्यक): Something that is not needed or required.
 
 
• **Example:** Buying unnecessary items can lead to financial problems.
